answer_1.quote: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) has achieved impressive performance when large amounts of parallel sentences are available.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates synthetic parallel data and improves translation outputs via domain-repaired back-translation.

answer_2.quote: Experimental results on adapting NMT models between specific domains and from the general domain to specific domains show that our proposed method obtains 15.79 and 4.47 BLEU improvements on average over unadapted models and backtranslation, respectively.
